title: Define aggregated shopping list value types
description: Create `Aggregation.swift` with the public `AggregatedShoppingList`, `AggregatedAisle`, and `AggregatedItem` value types and their API surface exactly as required for downstream callers.
acceptance_criteria: The three public aggregate structs conform to `Sendable` and `Equatable` and expose the specified stored properties.
Public API comments describe the nil `Other` aisle bucket and quantity list semantics without introducing rendering or I/O concerns.

- Accurate touched files, changed files, risks, and follow-up handoff fields.
